page_title: LEV 3-1 BOC | Bayer Leverkusen v Bochum 28/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The manager makes a subsitution with Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) coming on for Exequiel Palacios.
90+2' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the left post.
90+2' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Substitution. Jeremie Frimpong is replaced by Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen).
89' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Victor Boniface will be replaced by Emiliano Buendia (Bayer Leverkusen).
87' Myron Boadu (Bochum) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
87' 3 - 1 Goal! Exequiel Palacios plays a pass to the feet of Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen), and he shoots into the bottom right corner from inside the box. It's 3:1.
85' Ibrahima Sissoko comes off the pitch to be replaced by Dani de Wit (Bochum).
82' The goal by Bayer Leverkusen is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
81' Wait! Referee Sven Jablonski has indicated he is going to review the Bayer Leverkusen goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
80' Goal! Jeremie Frimpong provides Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 3:1.

78' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Aleix Garcia. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
76' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
75' Gerrit Holtmann will be replaced by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum).
75' Dieter Hecking prepares a substitution. Philipp Hofmann is replaced by Myron Boadu (Bochum).
74' The attendance for today's match is 30210.
73' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Sven Jablonski saw the whole situation.
71' It will be a substitution. Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is ready to enter the pitch as Patrik Schick walks off.
70' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
70' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.
69' Felix Passlack (Bochum) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Bochum have been awarded a corner kick.
68' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bochum was in an offside position.
67' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but Timo Horn comes off his line to gather the ball.

66' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
65' Matus Bero (Bochum) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
61' Referee Sven Jablonski points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) goes wild in celebration.
61' The Bayer Leverkusen players halt their celebrations as referee Sven Jablonski makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

60' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Piero Hincapie plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:1.
59' The referee blows his whistle after Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. A free kick to Bayer Leverkusen.
57' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
55' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
53' Matus Bero (Bochum) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Lukas Hradecky anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
53' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

52' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner kick.
52' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) makes a rough challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bayer Leverkusen.
48' Good clearance! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
46' What a sweet touch by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Timo Horn to hold.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45+1' Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bochum.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' The referee blows his whistle as Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) was too aggressive in his challenge.
45' A pass from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Timo Horn and the move breaks down.
42' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
41' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Bochum seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
37' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Matus Bero (Bochum), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
37' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
36' A cross from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

33' Tom Krauss (Bochum) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Sven Jablonski with no other option than to blow for a foul.
30' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Victor Boniface, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
30' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee blows his whistle, Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
28' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) is flagged for offside.

26' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Felix Passlack (Bochum) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the left post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Lukas Hradecky, so the score changes to 1:1.
26' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Lukas Hradecky is alert and denies him with a nice save.
24' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Sven Jablonski has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

20' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) tries his luck from the edge of the box and scores with an accurate shot inside the right post. Exequiel Palacios provided an assist for the goal.
18' Great teamplay by Bayer Leverkusen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
16' One of the Bochum players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
15' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
13' Sven Jablonski interrupts the game. One of the players from Bochum won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick.

12' The Bayer Leverkusen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break. Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 77:23.
10' Felix Passlack (Bochum) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

9' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Timo Horn pulls off an easy save.
8' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
7' Tom Krauss (Bochum) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Sven Jablonski no option but to blow his whistle.
4' A pass from Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Timo Horn and the move breaks down.
4' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) prepares to take a corner kick.
3' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
2' Bayer Leverkusen enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bochum will kick-off.
Sven Jablonski is introduced as the referee for today's match.
